questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw onions are harvested globally in a single year?
reasoning: Global onion production is estimated at roughly 105 million metric tonnes annually
Converting tonnes to kilograms multiplies the value by one thousand
This gives a total of approximately 105 billion kilograms produced worldwide

questions.prompt: How many total metres are traversed by a cargo ship crossing the Pacific Ocean along a typical major port route?
reasoning: A typical trans-Pacific shipping route between Asia and North America spans about 9000 kilometres
Converting kilometres to metres requires multiplying by one thousand
This results in approximately 9 million metres per voyage

questions.prompt: How many total individual sheets of paper are bound inside all telephone directories distributed across major metropolitan areas in Japan in a single year?
reasoning: Major Japanese cities print around 5 million directories annually
Each comprehensive directory contains an average of about 50 pages or sheets of thin paper
Multiplying 5 million directories by 50 sheets yields 250 million total sheets
